name: @omadia/api-key-auth
description: Server-to-server API-key authentication for omadia (issue #439). Owns the ONE implementation of mint/hash/verify, the vault-backed key store with per-key scopes, the per-key rate limiter, the usage audit log, and the mountable `requireApiKey` Express middleware. Deliberately dependency-free (except express types) so both the kernel and any plugin can consume it without a layering inversion.
